description: Proposed single storey wraparound extension to the ground floor flat (92A) and rear dormer and front rooflights to the first floor flat (92B).
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>The works hereby approved shall not be carried out unless in accordance with the approved Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) and Tree Protection Plan (TPP) (ROAVR Group). Any permanent hard surfacing within Root Protection Areas (RPAs) of retained trees should be installed and maintained in line with the approved AMS using a ‘no-dig’ method as outlined within the report.</p><p>Reason: To safeguard existing tree(s) in the interests of visual amenity, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020) and pursuant to Section 197 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.</p>

<p>No mechanical excavation shall occur within the Root Protection Area (RPA); this is because where roots are encountered by excavators the roots can sustain longitudinal shattering which causes extensive damage to the tree. Excavations of the upper 750mm associated with any construction activities within the RPA shall be carried out carefully and by hand tools only e.g. spades, shovels, trowels etc. Care must be taken to avoid damage to the bark of parts of roots that will be retained. If significant roots (i.e. above 25mm diameter), are discovered during the excavations then they must be retained. Small roots (i.e. below 25mm), may be severed using clean, sharp hand tools.</p><p>Reason: To protect the root systems of off-site retained trees in accordance with BS 5837:2012 and Policy LP51.</p>

<p>Prior to occupation, at least 1 bird/bat box shall be provided below eaves level at the development hereby approved and thereafter retained.&nbsp; </p><p>REASON: In the interests of improvements to biodiversity.</p>
